status: DECLARED after the exploration disclosed below and BEFORE the governing run (tools/run_own_motion_v2.py --score), which recomputes every number from scratch: the v62 development proxy (v61 proxy -> own_motion_v1's om_b2700_w100, month-blocked, exactly as tools/run_own_motion.py --score), the twelve-month table after own_motion_v1, the triggers at the five airports from the raw files, identity tables and adsb.lol day files, and the readings. The tunnel-19 screen read the same development months with the same labels; the evidence not from the exploration is the label-free ranking dry run.
mechanism: own_motion_v1's mechanism carried to the five other airports with adsb.lol surface coverage (EHAM, EDDM, LSZH, LEMD, LEBL). A departure the shipped matcher does not trace from its gate can still be seen moving: its own aircraft (ICAO address) blocked in at the departure's own stand as an arrival and later shows ground points at >= 3 kt; the off-block is not earlier than that first motion, label >= B. At these airports aircraft are often repositioned and come back, so one condition is added: the aircraft does not return to its parking fix after the motion ('no return'). Validity on all twelve 2025 months (label >= B - 60 s, rows not traced from the gate, same stand, no return, 60 < B <= 2,700 s): at least 95.0% in every month at every one of the five airports (EHAM 95.0-98.7%, EDDM 99.4-99.8%, LSZH 99.7-99.9%, LEMD 99.9%, LEBL 98.6-99.9%; runs/dig/case_files2/validity.txt).

procedure.position: the last layer, after own_motion_v1: v62's chain (runner v55m -> no-NM rematch -> v48's reconciliation -> extreme-day layer -> variance re-allocation -> guarded stacking residual -> intruder stand bound -> identity extension -> own-motion bound v1) -> THIS LAYER. v1's rows (EDDF / EGLL / LFPG) and this layer's rows (the five airports) are disjoint by airport.
procedure.identity: tunnel 11's identity tables runs/dig/position/ids_<2025-MM | ranking>.parquet (built by runs/dig/position/build_pos.py, re-implemented as tools/run_own_motion_v2.py --build-ids for a new file): each movement at the eight ADS-B airports gets the ICAO address of the nearest adsb.lol surface-file point of the same callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else the no-NM rematch key map runs/rematch_nonm/key_map.parquet on FLIGHT_mvt) at the same airport within 600 s of its take-off / landing time (day files of that day and the next). No departure label or departure block time is read.

trigger.not_gate_traced: adsb_gate != 1 (src/prc2026_adsb/features.departure_features on the take-off month's matches2 file; dark or unmatched rows)
trigger.inbound: the latest identified arrival of the same ICAO address at the same airport whose in-block precedes the take-off (merge_asof backward on take-off; the take-off month's file and, for 2025, the previous month's file), 600 s to 64,800 s before take-off, at the departure's own stand (STAND_mvt equal, both present)
trigger.first_motion: the aircraft's adsb.lol surface points at that airport with ground = True, take-off day and the day before, strictly after the inbound's in-block and not after take-off; the first with gs >= 3 kt strictly after in-block + 120 s; B = take-off - its time
trigger.no_return: parking fix = median lat / lon of the ground points with gs <= 1.5 kt strictly after in-block + 120 s and before the first motion; the trigger fails if any ground point after the first motion with gs <= 1.5 kt, more than 300 s after it, lies within 60 m of that fix (no fix: no return)

procedure.value: p + w (B + o(airport) - p), w = 0.5; o(airport) = mean of label - B over the fitting months' candidate rows of that airport, shrunk with weight 20 rows to the pooled mean of the candidate airports; nearest integer (numpy.rint) in the export; no clipping
procedure.fitting_side: candidates of the fitting months from the twelve-month table after own_motion_v1 (runs/daily_totals/rows12.parquet `stack` -> accepted intruder bound -> identity extension -> own_motion_v1 om_b2700_w100, each month-blocked exactly as in their governing runs; column after3); development month m and twelve-month month m: every other 2025 month; ranking: all twelve 2025 months. On all twelve months (screen): EDDM +50.7, EHAM -17.9, LEBL +152.3, LEMD +88.1, LSZH +46.4 s
procedure.free_parameters: the offsets o only; the airports, 600 s / 64,800 s, 120 s, 3 kt, 1.5 kt / 60 m / 300 s (no return), 60 / 2,700 s and w are fixed here

control.development: the v62 development proxy: runs/dig/census61/dev_v61.parquet `v61` (SHA-256 9739d9c5bfa6258affaf8f9a6db3c001a46c1e1e92308bebcdcd6920c51448de) -> own_motion_v1 om_b2700_w100 month-blocked, rebuilt in-process with tools/run_own_motion.py's functions (triggers, twelve_after, dev_table, candidates, fit, values); the governing run requires its month RMSEs to equal docs/own_motion/results_v1.json's control x (1 + pct / 100) to 1e-9 relative
control.alternative_control: --control PATH --control-col NAME --control-sha256 HASH: any chain proxy of the four development months with the same rows (the v63 chain proxy if stack_resid_v3 is accepted first; see 'sequencing')
control.twelve: rows12 `stack` after the accepted intruder bound, the identity extension and own_motion_v1 (month-blocked; column after3)

rule.text: v57's rule, as own_motion_v1: accepted when (1) no development month (January, July, November, December 2025) is worse than the control by more than 0.005% of its RMSE (all rows); (2) the mean change over the equal-footing months (January, July, December 2025) is at most -0.02%; (3) every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; (4) in the twelve-month check every month is better or unchanged
rule.intervals: paired-day bootstrap over UTC take-off days, 2,000 replicates, seed 20261003, relative RMSE change (tools/run_intruder_bound.interval)

sequencing: stack_resid_v3 (configs/stack_resid_v3.json, another agent; built as v63 if accepted) changes the chain under this layer. If stack_resid_v3 is accepted and built before this layer is built, this rule is re-run on the v63 chain proxy (tools/run_own_motion_v2.py --score --control <the v63 development proxy>) and must pass again there before any build; the build is then v64 on v63. If stack_resid_v3 is not accepted, the build is v63 on v62. Nothing is built while v63 is unresolved.
